concept: Accepting feedback without becoming defensive, even when it stings
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Lao Tzu's teachability tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student receives realistic, fair but uncomfortable feedback on something they worked hard on
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to respond in the moment, and what they do with the feedback afterward
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on the difference between defending yourself and actually hearing the feedback

assessment.success_marker: student identifies at least one genuinely useful part of the feedback, rather than dismissing it entirely
